sector: Luxury food services (events catering, casual dining and cloud kitchens, banquets)

company_pe.source: RHP pp. 175-176 (Basis for Offer Price); PAT p. 90
company_pe.note: The RHP gives no industry P/E: it states there are no listed peers in India or globally (p. 176). FY26 PAT carries almost no tax (Rs -0.11 cr on Rs 29.00 cr PBT); at a normal 25.17% rate EPS would be about Rs 4.15 (P/E 46x at Rs 191). H1 FY27 EPS Rs -3.09 (seasonal loss). Price band confirmed by the company on 23-Nov-2026.

business_stage: Scaling, recently profitable (loss in FY24; profit FY25-26; seasonal H1 losses)

anchor.source: Anchor bidding 25-Nov-2026; allocation not yet published at writing

headline: A Mumbai-based luxury caterer, restaurant and banquet operator (FY26 revenue Rs 567 cr, PAT Rs 29 cr with almost no tax, loss-making every first half) raising Rs 192 cr for new banquets, a kitchen and UAE restaurants, priced at 41x FY26 earnings (about 55x at a normal tax rate) with an Income Tax search still open; DCF fair value Rs 60 against Rs 191 (Avoid).
red_flags: FY26 tax a Rs 0.11 cr credit on Rs 29.00 cr PBT (earlier losses); normal-tax P/E about 55x at Rs 191 (p. 90)
Income Tax search and seizure 17-21 Dec-2025, Rs 1.06 cr cash seized, block assessment (s.158BC) pending; auditor emphasis of matter (pp. 35, 45)
IPO band 47% below the Rs 363 a share paid by investors in FY25-26 (p. 329); Reg 6(2) issue: QIB at least 75%, retail up to 10% (p. 442)
No sites identified and no orders placed for the IPO-funded kitchen, banquets and UAE restaurants (pp. 22-24)
Band Rs 181-191 (confirmed); DCF fair value Rs 32 / 60 / 90 vs Rs 191

strengths: Leading organised luxury wedding caterer by FY25 revenue among peers (p. 175)
Seven centralised kitchens, 100,000 meals a day (p. 152)
weaknesses: 11 restaurants and 10 cloud kitchens shut since Apr-2023 (p. 25)
opportunities: Wedding catering projected to grow 12% a year to FY30 (p. 205)
Two new banquets and a Rajasthan kitchen (p. 150)

flags: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
model.reverse_dcf: Current free cash flow is negative, so no multiple can be stated: the price assumes cash generation improves from here.

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the upper band of Rs 191 (confirmed by the company's price-band announcement on 23-Nov-2026): Neutral value Rs 60 is 68.8% below and the Bull value Rs 90 is also below the price, so the call is Avoid; the same at the Rs 181 floor. DCF only: the RHP states there are no listed peers (p. 176).
reference_note: Band Rs 181-191, lot 78 (company announcement, 23-Nov-2026; RHP prints [●]). Shares were issued at Rs 363 in FY25-26 (p. 329). At Rs 191: 6.24 crore post-offer shares, market cap Rs 1,191 cr; P/E 40.9x FY26 PAT (about 55x at a 25.17% tax rate); company's own P/E 34.2x basic / 34.9x diluted; P/B 2.9x post-offer; EV/EBITDA 19.2x FY26 EBITDA after lease rentals.
